title: CCP beacon-format vector encodes obsolete reserved layout and endianness
description: While aligning the canonical TDMA slot formula, test/vectors/ccp_beacon_format.json was found to define the 24-byte beacon header as epoch/num_slots/SFN/timestamp/flags plus 10 reserved bytes, label the multibyte example fields little-endian, truncate a microsecond timestamp to zeros, and say the codec is unimplemented. Normative spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.2 instead defines unsigned big-endian epoch, SFN, and timestamp followed by rx_chains, setup_window, occupied_time, 50 ms guard, and channel_mask; current implementations/vectors should use that contract. Replace the placeholder metadata and example with an exact independently decoded 24-byte header and add executable Python field/byte assertions.
